essentialTerminology.definition: The inspired canonical writings received by the Church as the word of God in human words.
The one God eternally subsisting as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit: three divine Persons, one divine nature.
The eternal Son's assumption of a complete human nature without ceasing to be divine.
The title 'God-bearer' or 'Mother of God,' safeguarding that the one born of Mary is the divine Person of the Son.

scriptureEvidence.paraphrase: Shared human dignity rests on creation in God's image and governs Christian speech about every neighbour.
Paul listens, identifies points of contact, corrects error, and proclaims creation, repentance, judgment, and resurrection without contempt.
Christian explanation is joined to reverence, a clear conscience, and conduct that does not betray the hope being defended.
